_comment: SCALPING V3 — EXPECTED_RANGE_SCALPER. RESEARCH DEFAULTS, not claimed-optimal. DECISION-SUPPORT / PAPER-ONLY. Long-only. Disabled by default. Completely isolated from every existing strategy (Swing, Breakout, Adaptive Selector, AI, the fixed-2% Scalping strategy, the Intraday Range Scalper, the Event-Driven Data Gate and the Rubix collector). Selection is liquidity-first: high consistent volume/turnover ranks above high volatility; a highly volatile but illiquid stock must never rank above a liquid, consistently active one.
_liquidity_hard_gate_comment: Research defaults for the liquidity hard gate. A symbol failing these is flagged (LIQUIDITY_TOO_LOW / VOLUME_UNRELIABLE / DATA_INSUFFICIENT) and excluded from the best-candidate views regardless of volatility.
_live_gate_comment: Live executability thresholds (Rubix quote reliability). These never alter the historical ranking.
_expected_range_comment: Percentiles applied to the historical distributions of upside and downside excursion from the previous completed Close. Ranges are intentionally allowed to be asymmetric.
_no_chase_comment: When the expected remaining upside to the expected High is below the fixed target, the symbol is RANGE_CONSUMED / DO_NOT_CHASE.
_paper_mode_comment: Paper forward recording is ENABLED to collect unbiased forward evidence. This records scenarios (all WAIT/READY/rejected states) and outcomes; it NEVER places an order, never auto-executes, and never enables production. Range percentiles, score weights and the fixed +2%/-2% target/stop are unchanged.
_daily_bridge_comment: Overlay locally-finalized Rubix completed-daily bars (FINAL only) onto the Yahoo history so a locally-finalized previous session prevents a false HISTORY_STALE without waiting for Yahoo. Never overwrites a Yahoo row; external providers stay disabled until audited. Does not change any expected-range formula, weight, TP or SL.
